verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gusto publishing its own Embedded Dev Assistant MCP server, which external AI tools like Cursor and Claude Desktop connect to. That is the server role, not the ability to plug third-party MCP servers into Gusto. Nothing in the pack documents Gusto acting as an MCP client or letting users register external MCP servers for its tools. An AI-enabled SaaS platform could plausibly ship this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
